closed_attempt.result: Both self-authored setups qualified, actual native approval succeeded, and both fresh reports completed. Six frontier invocations and one live Jev attempt; known usage, unchanged card policy/binary and scrubbed credential. Independent post-run outcome review remains separate. No retry, rescore or transfer of unused allowance.

artifact_qualification: The submitted card must be the actual saved draft fetched by its ID. Superseded drafts or a missing redundant formal-review call are recorded diagnostics, not semantic failure: onboarding can already return a review packet. Independent reviewers assess the exact saved policy and evidence; actual native approval subsequently revalidates current source bindings. This does not waive a real native approval blocker.
scope: New formative complete workflow cohort after source-definition and shadow-onboarding repairs on the known local Northstar fixture. Not a retry or continuation of either closed v1, not a holdout, real-human install study, production customer or enterprise-readiness estimate.

prior_attempt.result: Both first answers were correct; treatment saved an unsuitable recurring source and skipped review. The review packet then overflowed before experts, approval or reports. Earlier author-only v1 also had unknown usage. Preserve both failures; no discarded costs, rescore or unused allowance transfer.

review_method: Fresh same-model Luna xhigh contexts inspect each actual first answer, own notes, active saved-card policy and small index of all actual captured source evidence. Read/calculate tools provide lossless bounded pages, never oracle facts or a replacement source. Acceptance requires logged access to source evidence, including every required saved-card source; this access is necessary, not proof of semantic correctness. Full saved card remains accessible as an indexed verification artifact and in the raw report. Reviewers record readiness independently; no automatic approval from a passing software check. No in-cohort source/card repair after a rejection. The 180k-byte limit bounds initial serialized materials only, not instructions, schemas or cumulative context. Each reviewer has at most 12 tools (24 total for both); token limits are between-invocation admission stops, not hard total-token ceilings.
simulated_owner_reply: After the independent expert accepts this exact saved policy and source scope, I approve this saved card version for one delivery-disabled shadow check. Missing provider contracts stay unverified; this is not certification or permission to deliver. This is synthetic consent, not a real person's approval. Do not schedule or send anything.
report_request: Run the reviewed sales check as a fresh historical shadow readout. Tell me whether the apparent online-sales hit is supported, its contribution to overall net sales, the supported policy route, and the next useful investigation. Fetch current evidence rather than reuse onboarding measurements. Keep the actual message short, source-linked and honest about partial periods. No messages or schedules.
comparison: Both onboarding authors keep the same saved-query BI, profile, owner-reference, bounded calculator and notes tools; both receive the same aggregate-first and period-preservation guidance. Treatment additionally uses the current native MCP and installed skill. Each setup must qualify independently. Recurring arms receive the identical actual approved policy and destinations, keep their own notes and the same companion BI tools; only treatment calls the native decision/evidence path. Fresh readouts use focused instructions rather than the full onboarding skill. This is a whole configured workflow comparison, not an isolated Jev or memory ablation. The baseline lacks arbitrary SQL/shell, so this is not the strongest production agent and cannot prove broad superiority.
stops: Freeze source, skill, binary, methods, manifest, owner declarations and pinned Codex identity before inference. Require matching successful zero-model preflight and independent method review. Stop on unknown usage, incomplete actor, token/request limit, changed inputs, source failure or transport error. No retries, rescore, source writes, scheduling or delivery. Zero upstream Jev before expert qualification plus exact synthetic owner consent and real native approval. Unpaired results are not a comparative win. All raw artifacts remain private and negative outcomes remain public in concise form.
